subject: Mapping variables to parameters in facet strips?

messages.author: d4005c0b4ec1132e
messages.subject: Mapping variables to parameters in facet strips?
parts:
I would like to use map the fill of the strip background in a faceted
plot to a variable in my dataframe, but I'm not clear how to do this.

I've tried a few things like this:
Myplot<-ggplot(Mydata, aes(x=Var.A, y=Var.B) + facet_wrap(~Var.C)
Myplot + opts(strip.background=theme_rect(aes(fill = Var.D)))
But this results in all strips being white with a black outline.

I've also tried manually creating a vector of fill colors, but that
results in all panels using only the first element in that vector.

Any suggestions?
